body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings of claims in the application:
body.br:
SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.2570.617
1. (Original) An acousto-optic imaging system comprising:at least one transducer configured to transmit an ultrasound signal having a fundamental frequencyf; and
at least one optical sensor configured to produce one or more optical responses upon receiving harmonic or subharmonic ultrasound echoes corresponding to the transmitted ultrasound signal, wherein the at least one optical sensor has a bandwidth ranging from at least f/M to Nf, where M and N are integers greater than 1.
2. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one optical sensor is configured to produce at least a portion of the one or more optical responses upon receiving ultrasound echoes having a super-harmonic frequency of at least Qf, where Q is an integer 3 or greater.
3. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one optical sensor is configured to produce at least a portion of the one or more optical responses upon receiving ultrasound echoes having a frequency of 2f orf
4. (Cancelled)
5. (Cancelled)

7. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the fundamental frequencyf is a first fundamental frequencyfl, and the at least one transducer is configured to generate a second ultrasound signal having a second fundamental frequencyfSVG {EMBED HERE} 0.1530.163
8. (Original) The system of claim 7, wherein the at least one optical sensor is configured to produce at least a portion of the one or more optical responses upon receiving ultrasound echoes that correspond to a frequency of one or more linear combinations nfi+ wherein n and m are integers such that nfA + mfp is a positive number.SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.1530.167

10. (Original) The system of claim 1, further comprising a computer-readable medium storing instructions to generate an image based on the one or more optical responses of the at least one optical sensor.
11. (Original) The system of claim 1, further comprising a computer-readable medium storing instructions to generate an image based on a change in the one or more optical responses of the at least one optical sensor.
12. (Cancelled)
13. (Original) The system of claim 11, wherein the change indicates a spectral shift and each optical response includes at least one spectral resonance feature with a full-width at half-maxima (FWHM) that is smaller than the spectral shift.

18. (Original) The system of claim 17, wherein the at least one optical sensor is embedded in a polymer structure with an effective refractive index lower than the effective refractive index of the at least one optical sensor.

41. (Original) A method of acousto-optic imaging comprising:transmitting to a medium one or more ultrasound signals having one or more fundamental frequencies;
detecting at least one change in an optical response of one or more optical detectors, wherein the at least one change in the optical response is produced upon receiving ultrasound echoes corresponding to the one or more ultrasound signals, wherein at least a portion of the
SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.2830.617received ultrasound echoes has a frequency that is a super-harmonic frequency of the one or more fundamental frequencies, a subharmonic frequency of the one or more fundamental frequencies, an ultra-harmonic frequency of the one or more fundamental frequencies, or a linear combination of the one or more fundamental frequencies; and
generating an image of the medium based on the detected change in the optical response.
